remediation_note: Version 3.0.0 re-executed Stage 1-5 under generalized declarative bio-suite-supervisor + bio-suite-seqnet codon QC: (1) strict title classification separated the 28 short 28S/18S rRNA fallback accessions from the 36 complete mitogenomes so zero ribosomal sequences entered the COX1 (S3) codon alignment; (2) Stage 4 functional families were de-mixed into single-family full-length non-EST cohorts (FAM-01 GH5 beta-1,4-endoglucanase, FAM-02 CRT1 calreticulin, FAM-03 Hsp70, FAM-04 C. elegans P450) preserving conserved CYP I-helix and Cys-loop residues on 1TQN; (3) Skyline Cohorts L2 and L5 (Supp S2) were scoped cleanly to single-subunit LSU 28S D2-D3 rDNA.

manuscript_prose.section1_title: Convergent Origins of Stylet Plant Parasitism, HGT Cellulases & Pest Diversification Across Phylum Nematoda
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: Plant-parasitic nematodes (Phylum Nematoda) inflict major global crop losses across staple grains, legumes, solanaceous tubers, perennial orchards, and forestry biomes. Herbivory on living plants arose independently across Clade I Dorylaimia virus vectors (Longidoridae, Trichodoridae), Clade IVa Aphelenchoidea (Bursaphelenchus xylophilus, Aphelenchoides besseyi), and the Clade IVb Tylenchomorpha radiation (Criconematidae, Tylenchulidae, Anguinidae, Hoplolaimidae, Pratylenchidae, Heteroderidae, Meloidogynidae) rooted on Chromadorea bacteriovore and entomopathogenic outgroups.
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In v3.0.0, all 64 stratified Nematoda OTUs route through generalized bio-suite-seqnet with strict GenBank FASTA title classification separating complete mitogenomes from short 28S/18S rRNA submissions, ensuring pure COX1 codon frames under Invertebrate Mitochondrial Code 5 while auditing four homogeneous Universal Standard Code 1 nuclear functional families (GH5, CRT1, hsp-70, and P450).

manuscript_prose.section4_title: HGT Cellulase, Calreticulin Effector, Hsp70 & Cytochrome P450 Selection (1TQN)
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across verified non-EST Nematoda nuclear coding alignments under Universal Standard Code 1, 61-state Goldman-Yang codon models quantify purifying constraint and episodic selection on horizontally transferred GH5 beta-1,4-endoglucanases (FAM-01), esophageal gland calreticulin CRT1 effectors (FAM-02), anhydrobiosis chaperone hsp-70 (FAM-03), and microsomal detoxification cytochrome P450s (FAM-04: cyp-31A2 / CYP14 / CYP33 / CYP35) threaded onto PDB 1TQN (2.05 A) preserving the distal I-helix dioxygen groove and Cys442 proximal heme-thiolate bond.
manuscript_prose.section5_title: Global Nematode Skylines (mtDNA vs. 28S rDNA) & Stage 3C COI-5P Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Integrating partitioned RY3 phylogenomics, Quartet MSC reconciliation, and functional codon selection across Phylum Nematoda clarifies both deep Cambrian-Mesozoic stylet origins and Cenozoic polyploid Meloidogyne crop-pest radiations while eliminating compositional LBA artifacts in AT-rich Chromadorean mitogenomes.

Strict pre-MSA motif and post-MSA codon auditing under Universal Standard Code 1 guarantees zero spurious termination artifacts and isolates genuine evolutionary conservation across HGT GH5 cellulases, CRT1 stylet effectors, hsp-70 chaperones, and detoxification P450s.

Separating mitochondrial loci cleanly from nuclear LSU 28S D2-D3 rDNA cohorts prevents inter-subunit alignment stagger in Katoh E-INS-i skylines and grounds downstream bridgehead comparisons across transoceanic seed-potato, soybean, and timber trade corridors.
manuscript_prose.abstract_context: Understanding how plant parasitism evolved repeatedly across nematodes requires resolving deep phylum-level relationships alongside the conservation of horizontally acquired cellulases, stylet effectors, and detoxification enzymes.
manuscript_prose.executive_summary_lead: traces plant-parasitism, HGT cellulases, and demography across pest nematodes
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Plant-parasitic and free-living nematodes across Phylum Nematoda span Chromadorea outgroups [A] through Clade I virus vectors [B], Aphelenchoidea [C], and sedentary cyst/root-knot parasites [D]-[G] in Version 3.0.0.
